If there is a passage between the mortal world and [[the Underworld]], surely such spirits would know how to find it.}} The [[Tomb of the Primeval Kings]] is where ancient [[Elona|Elonian]] kings are buried, along with some famous heroes such as [[Lord Victo]]. This is where players form parties to fight against the forces of chaos in the explorable areas [[The Underworld (explorable area)|the Underworld]], [[Scarred Earth]], [[The Courtyard]], and [[The Hall of Heroes]]. ==History== {{see|Letters from Kuro}} The [[Primeval Kings]] of Elona were buried here from 229 [[Dynastic Reckoning|DR]] until 652 DR, when the [[Scarab Plague]] decimated the population of [[Istan]] and wiped out the Royal House of the [[Primeval Dynasty]]. 400 years later, [[Lord Odran]] opened a portal from here to [[the Rift]]. After he died, the portal could be accessed by anyone, and mortals would travel regularly into [[the Mists]] to battle each other for the [[Favor of the Gods]]. This arrangement lasted for 200 years, until, just after the [[Wintersday 2005|Wintersday celebrations]] in 1272 DR, the forces of [[Dhuum]] and [[Abaddon]] interrupted the tournament. They defeated the spirits of [[Turai Ossa|Warmarshal Turai]], Lord Victo, and the Primeval monarchs, and began to slip through Odran's portal into the mortal world. By this point they had attracted the attention of both the [[Zaishen Order]] and the [[Order of the Sunspears]], organizations that now fight back the darkness. As compensation for the destroyed tournament grounds, the Zaishen have offered access to their home on [[the Battle Isles]] for all the stranded fighters. On these isles, another portal opened by Odran in [[Heroes' Ascent]] lies ready for use. ==Getting there== Run through the [[portal]] in [[The Dragon's Lair (outpost)|The Dragon's Lair]] mission outpost. ==NPCs== *{{w}}{{r}} 28 [[Ghostly Hero (PvE)|Ghostly Hero]] *{{mo}} 20 [[Priest]] *{{x}} 20 [[Acolyte Jaikaro]] *{{x}} 20 [[Acolyte Quanjo]] *{{x}} 20 [[Acolyte Senfai]] *{{x}} 20 [[Commander Kuro]] *{{x}} 20 [[Rocius]] ===Services=== *{{x}} 20 [[Acolyte Singpa]] ([[merchant]]) *{{x}} 20 [[Monay]] ([[rune trader]]) *{{x}} 10 [[Sigil Trader]] *{{x}} 24 [[Xunlai Chest]] ([[vault box|storage]]) *{{x}} 15 [[Xunlai Agent]] ([[storage upgrades]]) ====Henchmen==== *{{w}} 20 [[Zaishen Fighter]] (x2) *{{r}} 20 [[Zaishen Archer]] (x2) *{{mo}} 20 [[Zaishen Healer]] (x2) *{{e}} 20 [[Zaishen Mage]] (x2) ==Notes== *During every [[Halloween]] festival and [[Wintersday 2005]], the Tomb was decorated to look more festive. *Known monarchs that are buried here include [[King Elswyth]], [[King Kole]], [[King Millius]], [[Queen Nadijeh]], and [[King Wenslauss]]. *Complete exploration of this outpost contributes approximately 0.4% to the Tyrian [[Cartographer]] title. {{bug|The [[Sigil Trader]] is missing from [[International District]]s.}} ==Trivia== *The Tomb of the Primeval Kings outpost used to be the outpost from which players could access the PvP arena that is now known as [[Heroes' Ascent]]. *The [[Game updates/20060113|January 13, 2006]] and [[Game updates/20060119|January 19, 2006]] updates slowly progressed the corruption of the Tomb. *The Halloween decorations for the Tomb were created before the corruption, thus during Halloween the Tomb more closely resembles the original design. ==See also== {{gw2w}} *[[Ruins of the Tomb of the Primeval Kings]] *[[Tomb of the Primeval Kings (Halloween)]] {{Towns and outposts in the Crystal Desert}} [[Category:Primeval Kings|*]]
